The face landmark model used by DRAW is bundled at
../../models/face_landmarker.task. It is the MediaPipe Face Landmarker model
distributed by Google at:
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/latest/face_landmarker.task
